faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild engines for all Discovery generations?
faqLeft.a: Yes — we rebuild and replace engines across the full range, from the classic Discovery 1/2 through Discovery 3/4 to the current Discovery 5.

faqLeft.q: Do I keep my original engine, or do you send me a different one?
faqLeft.a: We rebuild the engine your Discovery already has wherever possible, avoiding the compatibility risks that come with fitting a used engine of unknown history.
Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqLeft.q: What warranty comes with a rebuild?
faqLeft.a: Every rebuild comes with a 12 month unlimited-mileage warranty.

faqRight.a: We collect your car nationwide from £70. Most vehicles are recovered within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: How much does a Discovery engine rebuild cost?
faqRight.a: Classic diesel rebuilds start from £1,900, TDV6/SDV6 (Discovery 3/4) from £2,400, modern Discovery 5 6-cylinder from £2,800, and V8 from £4,500. Exact price depends on engine code and condition — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqRight.q: Does the same issue affect every Discovery generation?
faqRight.a: No — each generation has its own pattern. Discovery 2's Td5 is known for injector and crank sensor wear; Discovery 3/4's TDV6/SDV6 for timing chain and bearing wear; the current Discovery 5's Ingenium diesel for the same timing-chain pattern seen across the modern Land Rover range. We know the difference and rebuild accordingly.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
